title: Pepper Roulade

media.caption: Cooking the peppers on a cast-iron griddle.
Final appearance with the roulades closed.

healthBenefits.title: Peppers boost immunity
healthBenefits.text: Bell peppers are exceptionally rich in vitamin C and carotenoids, supporting immune function and eye health.

healthBenefits.title: Anchovies provide omega-3s
healthBenefits.text: Salted anchovies deliver heart-healthy omega-3 fatty acids and vitamin B12, supporting cardiovascular and nerve health.

healthBenefits.title: Olive oil supports heart health
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil is rich in monounsaturated fats and polyphenols that help reduce inflammation and support cardiovascular health.

healthBenefits.title: Capers offer antioxidants
healthBenefits.text: Capers contain quercetin and rutin, plant compounds with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.

healthBenefits.title: Parsley adds micronutrients
healthBenefits.text: Fresh parsley contributes vitamin K, vitamin C, and antioxidants that support bone and immune health.

healthBenefits.title: Bread provides energy
healthBenefits.text: The bread soaked in milk adds carbohydrates for energy along with calcium and protein from the milk.

_ingredientsText:
4 peppers
 4 salted anchovies, chopped
 40 gr of salted capers
 4 slices of bread, without crusts
 1,5 dl of milk
 1 sprig of parsley, chopped
 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
 salt
 pepper
_preparationText:
1 - cottura su piastra di ghisa
2 - 4 preparazione della farcitura
5 preparazione dei peperoni alla farcitura
6 - 7 farcitura
8 - aspetto finale con chiusura degli involtini
